body:
## Summary
- revalidate formal latency report source manifests from the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate gate
- require known latency profiles plus threshold and observed-with-uncertainty fields on formal latency reports
- fail closed when latency evidence cannot apply its uncertainty budget instead of silently preserving a pass verdict

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_latency_evidence tools.tests.test_latency_preflight tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_phase0_module_ownership -v
- make evidence-tools-test
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- git diff --check

This hardens evidence validation only. It does not close the telemetry/latency archive gate or mark Phase 0 stable.
title: test(evidence): harden latency archive validation
